preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 200, inclusive.
The number of integers in the array is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The integer k is between 0 and 10^18, inclusive.
Each integer in the array is between 0 and 10^18, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the number of integers in all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == number of pairs (i, j) such that (A_i | A_j) + (A_i ^ A_j) + (A_i & A_j) == k + A_j for 1 <= i < j <= N
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the number of pairs (i, j) that satisfy the given condition.
